capabilities: save find-replace rules and run all enabled rules in order
create and reuse block references from paragraphs and jump back to sources
scan for and trash unused images after confirmation
export selected notes as Markdown with images or continuous long-page PDFs
organize rule pages with rename, duplicate, and drag-reorder
extras: Local-only: the README states it makes no network requests and contains no telemetry; image cleanup is intentionally conservative and only moves files to the Obsidian trash.
problem: Obsidian has no way to store recurring find-and-replace rules and re-run them in a set order across notes.
summary: Saved find-and-replace rule manager that runs rule sets in order, with block-reference copying, unused-image cleanup, and batch note export.
